scope: DenseLinearF32 provider dtype support; no full model/MTP/throughput conclusion

implementation.cpu: Original BF16/BF16 native path retained; typed SIMD dot otherwise, unsupported mixed F16 boundaries widen a 256-element stack tile only.
implementation.metal: Original rank2 BF16/BF16 path retained; all other dense combinations use F32-A matvec metadata, exact A widening when needed, actual source W dtype and batch pitch.
implementation.vulkan: Original rank2 BF16/BF16 path retained; other combinations use F32-A matvec and actual W dtype, with source precision F32 for F32/F32.

tests.coverage: Each backend: all 9 A/W dtype combinations, rank2/rank3, M1/M2/M17, independent batches, F32 A and W cancellation residuals; CPU additionally crosses its 256-element widening tile.

admission.cpu: Dense rank2 or aligned rank3 only; public dimension checks and plain F16/BF16/F32 domains.
admission.vulkan: Dense rank2 or aligned rank3; no new dtype limitation. This finite test does not claim every shader dimension/device.
admission.metal: New matvec paths require even N when K>=32, M<=INT16_MAX and all inputs/outputs <=INT32_MAX-1024 elements; otherwise decline. The old rank2 BF16/BF16 path retains its existing admission.

native_cache_boundary.gpu_libraries: Reused existing native Metal/Vulkan binaries; each predates the new GDN output-scale capability export.
native_cache_boundary.absent_contract_probe: Focused test-only exact int32 function returns 0, so GDN must decline. It never replaces Dense kernels, reports a supported contract, or modifies a cache binary.
